label: exp-2026-07-confidence-spread
custom_instructions: CONFIDENCE DISCIPLINE: Your stated confidence must reflect genuine conviction, using the full 0-100 scale. Reserve 70+ for decisions where the desk evidence is strongly aligned (multiple independent bullish/bearish signals, no unresolved dissent). Use 40-55 when evidence is mixed or thin. A confidence that would be the same for every ticker is a wasted signal - differentiate.
verdict_detail: Pre-registered reject rule met: e-value 76884 with leader = champion (24-1 on 25 informative pairs). The treatment also failed its own secondary signal - challenger/champion confidence stdev ratio 1.00 against a 2.0 target over 522 pairs; it shifted the mean down 2.98 pts instead of widening the spread.
